title: The Terrifying Change from Nice to Nightmare
description:
► One of Everything Bundle [Limited time]

On July 3, 2022, a Dodge County Sheriff’s deputy stopped a vehicle for speeding at 67 mph in a 55 mph zone in Beaver Dam, WI. The female driver soon exhibited signs of possible intoxication, and when the deputy tried to detain her, she became uncooperative. Due to her disruptive behavior, several additional units were called to assist. The situation escalated, and she continued to be a major challenge for the deputies throughout the night.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
